instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all text is written in natural, grammatically correct Russian (Cyrillic script).
Use data-testid attribute on all interactive components (buttons, tabs, modals, forms).
Ensure responsive behavior: desktop, tablet, and mobile layouts are flawlessly styled.

Do NOT use generic grey or dark mode backgrounds for the primary landing sections - maintain a fresh clinical feel with alternating white, light blue (#F0F7FF), light turquoise (#E6F4F8), and deep blue accents.
Ensure Sonner toasts are used for appointment form confirmation.
Ensure smooth scrolling to anchor sections (#services, #doctors, #diagnostics, #about, #reviews, #contacts).
